en: Excuse me...
Oh, hello there, little lady. What can I do for you?
Umm, are you the salon manager? The one Yoko-san is friends with?
Yep, that's me. You must be the one Yoko-chan told me about.
I'm Momiyama, manager of this salon. I'm also the head masseur.
I'm Haruka Sawamura. I heard you were into dance battles.
You heard right. I know I should really act my age, but I just love to dance. Can't get enough of shaking my booty, you know?
Are you up for a dance battle, Haruka-san?
Mwahahaha!
What are you laughing at?
Oh, you're the girl Yoko-san's working with.
Haruka Sawamura. It's nice to see you again.
Is something the matter? Or are you back for another dance battle? Mwahahaha.
No, not this time. I wanted your help in thinking of a present for Yoko-san.
A present?
Yes. She's been so good to me. I really would like to thank her by getting her something, but I have no idea what to get.
I thought that since you were friends with her, you might know what she likes.
No ideas?
It's not that. You see, she's already received a gift from you.
Didn't Yoko-chan tell you about that kid she wished she had helped? You know, her old friend?
Yoko-chan told me how you reminded her of her friend. And by helping you, she feels like she can finally be free of her regrets.
You, along with your hard work, are the greatest gift you could give her.
My hard work is a gift to Yoko-san, huh?
Yep. Plus, you performed in that costume that was originally meant for her friend. I'm sure it made Yoko-chan very happy.
(That's it! The best thing I can do for Yoko-san is to sing in that costume she gave me!)
Thank you so much, Momiyama-san! Now I know exactly what I can do for Yoko-san.
Glad I could help. And I'm glad this creepy old man is still good for something, haha.
You're not the least bit creepy! Now, you'll have to excuse me. I have to run!
Wait, Haruka-chan. What's the rush?
Yoko-san said she was leaving town soon, so I want to thank her before it's too late!
Yoko-chan's leaving?
Yes. That's why I'm in a rush! See you later!
Hmph, she's sure a handful.
(All right, time to give back to Yoko-san with the gift of song!)
Let's play a game of pool together!
(Guess Kaguya wants to shoot some pool.)
Really? I guess I'll just watch, then.
Really? In that case, I suppose we should go someplace that doesn't cost any money.
Sorry. Not really feelin' it.
What? Why did you even ask me on a date, then?
That was wicked fun! Call me again anytime! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
That was loads of fun! Gimme a call again anytime! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Wow, I can't believe it was that close! That really got my blood pumping good!
That was so much fun! This place is only a minute's walk from my house, so please call me again anytime! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Uncle Kaz! Do you think you can <Color:8>clear a single-player game of nine-ball without getting a foul<Color:Default>?
(Looks like Haruka wants me to <Color:8>play a round of pool<Color:Default>.)
Okay. Maybe you can <Color:8>play nine-ball<Color:Default> some other time.
No problem. Shall we get started?
Sorry to keep you waiting! So you know about this place too, Saejima-san?
If you wanted to play pool, we could have played in Kamurocho. Why did you call me all the way back here to Tsukimino!?
Sorry for the wait! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default> I shoulda figured you were a pool-playing sorta guy, Akiyama-san!
Ha. Well, want to get started?

There you are, Miss Idol Dancer. Ready for that dance
battle?
I'm sorry, but now isn't a good time.

No? Darn. Well, I'll be here, so whenever you're ready. Come
on back when you're free.
All right. I'll do it.

Heh, I can see why you're doing so well on the Princess
League. You've got spirit. I like that.
Let's not waste any more time, then!
Akari!
Huh? Oh, Haruka! What's wrong? You're all out of breath!
Akari, is it true? Did you really quit dancing?
Yeah... It's true.

But why!? You said your dream is to be a top choreographer
someday...
Say something, Akari!
You... You wouldn't understand.

Everything's fine for you. You're super pretty, and you have
amazing talent. But I don't have anything going for me at
all, not like you do.

I absolutely love dance. Sure, I want to be a choreographer.
That's why I put in so many hours practicing, more than
anybody I know.

Even when it came to dance battles, I was always thinking
about how I could win. I've always taken it very seriously.

That's why I thought I couldn't lose when it came to dance,
not even to you. But in the end, I was wrong.

How could I keep chasing the same silly dream after what
happened? It would just be foolish. No matter how I work, I
just don't have what it takes.

Akari, that just isn't true! Besides, there's still another
chance for you!

Look, this is a leaflet for the Dance Battle Summit. If you
make a good impression there, it'll open a whole new set of
doors for you... You'll enter, right?
...Sorry, Haruka, I'm not going.
Huh!? But why not!?

Because I already know what will happen. I can't keep
beating my head against the wall, you know?

But it's the perfect opportunity! Akari, you can't give up
on your dream.

Sure, that's fine for somebody like you to say! But when
you're an ordinary, mediocre person like me, sometimes the
best thing to do is quit.

Otherwise, you'll just keep getting hurt, and hurting the
people you care about, too.

That first time I talked to you, it wasn't just because I
wanted to be friends.

You're an idol, so I thought you might have connections and
be able to get me that much closer to my dream.
That's why I approached you, for my own selfish gain.
Akari...

That time with Christina, too. I thought surely I must be a
better dancer than you.

I thought you'd make me look good if I went up against you
in front of him.

I told myself Christina would be impressed if he saw me beat
a pro, and that's why I brought you along.

I know, I know. I'm the worst. I mean, stooping to something
that low all for the sake of my dream? And, to top it all
off, I didn't even succeed. Haha...

So now you get it, don't you? Now you see how destructive it
can be when a fool chases their dream, right?
That's why I gave up dance.

Haruka, I'm so sorry for all the rotten things I did. I'm
sorry I used you. It's fine if you hate me now. I don't
deserve to be your friend.

Good luck with your career. Remember me when your dream
comes true. I know you can do it, because you have real
talent. You have "it."
Well, I guess this is goodbye, Haruka.
Akari, wait!

I... I don't care about any of that. I'm glad you talked to
me that day. Really glad.

You know what I'm like⑬my personality. Besides, I'm always
working. Yui-chan is the only person who ever went out of
their way to talk to me.

I've been really lonely. But I told myself that's just how
it is for me, that it's my fate.

So when you talked to me that day, when you brought me along
to all kinds of places, when you showed me how much fun
dancing could be...
I was really, really glad.

I don't care why you talked to me that day. I'm just happy
you did.

It doesn't matter how we got our start. All that matters is
that we're friends now, right?

But we can't be friends now! Every time I look at you, I'm
forced to relive all kinds of bad memories.
Fine. We don't have to be friends, then!

But even if you don't consider us friends, I want you to at
least remember one thing.

Friends or not, I want you to know that I still like you,
Akari. I like you, and I care about you.

I'll be there at the Dance Battle Summit. I hope you'll be
there, too!

You love dance. And becoming a top choreographer is your
dream. Come on. Say that you'll dance with me one more time!
Yui-chan! Did you hear everything?
I see... Do you think Akari will show up?
I don't know, but I sure hope so.
She loves dance more than anybody, you know?

(Akari, please come to the summit! Please don't give up on
your dream!)

Thanks for doing this with Aya, Haruka. You've got this,
girl!
Sawamura-san. You ready for that dance battle yet?

Okay, sure. I get it. But if that ever changes, come back
and see me. I'll take you on anytime.
You will? Great, let's get started, then!
Oh, Haruka-chan. Are you ready to go?
I think I'd like to look around a little more.
Sure, go ahead. Just let me know when you're ready to leave.
Yes, I'm ready.
Okay, let's go, then. Come on, Akari-chan! We're leaving!
Coming!
Are you all done shopping, Yui-chan?

Yeah, I'm all done. I bought detergent and all kinds of
other stuff we need at the house.

Oh, that's right. You do the housework for your family,
don't you?

That's right. I have three little brothers, and now that
Mom's gone, I do all the cooking and laundry and cleaning.
Wow, I didn't know that...

What about you? Did you buy anything? Are you ready to
leave yet?

Do you think Yui's done shopping yet? She said she had to
get a few things...

Whenever I come to Don Quijote, I always see a million
things I want. Someday when I'm rich, I'm gonna buy
everything in the store!
Just buy the whole place out, huh?

That's right! Then I'll have all the snacks and drinks I
could ever want, 24/7!
Haruka Sawamura. Are you ready for our battle?

Hmph. Looks like you're the one who's chickenshit. Whatever,
if you ever work up enough courage, come back and see me.
I'll be here.

Good! Glad we're seeing eye to eye. Let's get right to it,
then!
私に話しかけるとPlayerがパス移動します。
Hey, Haruka! Come to give me some mon⑬ Uh, I mean, did you come to have an exciting dance battle?
Actually, I changed my mind.
All right, fine. I won't force you! But come on back soon! Please!
Yes, I'm ready!
Hey, wait a minute. You look exhausted! I can't let you dance when you're that tired.
Oh, I'm sorry! I guess I'd better rest up first.
Hey, hey. Not so fast. I'm gonna need at least 500 yen. How else am I going to make enough money for my plane ticket?
Oh. Right.
Fantastic! Okay, who do you want to challenge?
Akari, huh? You got it! Hold on just a sec.
Hi, Haruka!
Akari, are you all set to start?
Yup. I'm ready anytime!
Then let's go!
Maki, huh? You got it! Hold on just a sec.
Thanks for inviting me, Miss Idol Dancer.
Maki-san, let's have a showdown!
Hehe, I'm all better now, so you'd better watch out. I'll show you what the leader of the Hipsters can do!
Aya, huh? You got it! Hold on just a sec.
So we meet again, Sawamura-san. The time has finally come for me to take you down.
It's, um, nice to see you again, Aya-san.
It'll be a fair fight this time!
Exactly! Let's do this.
Judy, huh? You got it! Hold on just a sec.
Well, if it isn't Haruka Sawamura. How've you been?
Pretty good. How about you, Judy-san?
All right, that's enough chitchat. Let's get down to business. I won't go easy on you!
And I wouldn't want you to!
Mr. Momiyama, huh? You got it! Hold on just a sec.
Heheh. Another dance battle, Haruka-san?
Yes, please! If you wouldn't mind.
Not at all! Let's get to it, then! *cough* *cough*
Momiyama-san...?
Ririka, huh? You got it! Hold on just a sec.
Hello, Haruka-chan. It's been a while.
Hello, Ririka-san. I'm sorry about calling you out here like this.
It's cool. I didn't have anything better to do. So, should we get to it then?
Yes, let's go!
Ema, huh? You got it! Hold on just a sec.
Hello, Ema-chan. Would you like to have a dance battle?
Of course! But I won't go easy on you, you know!
Fine by me!
Himeko, huh? You got it! Hold on just a sec.
Never fear, Himeko-sama is here!
Thanks for coming, Himeko-chan. Want to have a dance battle with me?
Certainly! It'll be the perfect chance to show you my magnificent moves!
Hehe. Great!
Seira, huh? You got it! Hold on just a sec.
Hi, Haruka! So, what do you wanna do today?
Huh? Oh, this was about a dance battle, but... Didn't anyone tell you?
Oh? Oh! That's right! Okay, let's dance!
Yes, let's!
Noa Amon, huh? You got it! Hold on just a sec.
Heh. I didn't expect to be seeing you again so soon.
Yes, I'm a little surprised myself.
Whatever. Tell you what. I'll let you choose the kind of fight you want to lose at. Dance battle or concert battle?
I choose to have a dance battle.
A dance battle, huh? All right. Get ready to feel the sting of defeat!
I choose to have a concert battle.
A concert battle, huh? All right. Get ready to feel the sting of defeat!
